in_marathi.name: Eniya
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Love and Beauty
in_marathi.long_meaning: Eniya हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Eniya is a beautiful and enchanting name derived from the Sanskrit language. This name is believed to be the embodiment of love, beauty, and grace. According to Hindu mythology, Eniya is the goddess of love and fertility, who is worshipped for her nurturing and protective qualities. Her name is a source of inspiration and strength, symbolizing the power of love and compassion.
